review: 301.1-1: the combat variant used a declare attackers step with no attackers, a step Forge may skip; moved it to the beginning of combat step.

301.5b-1: put_by_giant was labelled does_not_fire although Stonehewer Giant's ability also puts the Equipment onto the battlefield unattached and attaches it afterwards; relabelled it 'other' and stated the unattached entry in expected.

301.5b-2: the Brass Squire + Apostle's Blessing version made the creature target illegal (protection from an artifact source), so the attach did nothing through 608.2b targeting, not through 301.5b's 'cannot be equipped' clause; rewrote it with Sigarda's Aid, a non-artifact source whose trigger legally targets Angelic Curator (protection from artifacts) and then cannot attach Bonesplitter to it.

301.5c-3: the does_not_fire variant moved Bonesplitter to Centaur Courser but kept Shock on Grizzly Bears, yet expected Courser to have 2 damage marked; changed the delta to Shock targeting Centaur Courser so the equipped creature stays and the expected outcome holds.
301.5e-1: added a forge_note that Forge may leave Bonesplitter in the graveyard instead of returning it unattached.
301.7a-1: removed an unobservable, inaccurate clause ('cannot be dealt damage as a creature') from the base expected.
301.5b-1: no one-fact change makes a cast Equipment enter attached; recorded in forge_notes that the contrast lives in 301.5e-1, and left the scenario without a does_not_fire variant.

scenarios.title: An artifact can be cast only in a main phase of its controller's turn with an empty stack

setup.notes: Bonesplitter has no flash. A has priority.

decisions: A attempts to cast Bonesplitter, tapping one Mountain.

variants.label: main1_empty_stack
variants.expected: Casting Bonesplitter is legal: can_play is true in A's first main phase with an empty stack, and the cost is {1}.

variants.label: main2_empty_stack
variants.delta: It is A's second main phase (step main2).
variants.expected: Casting Bonesplitter is legal: can_play is true.

variants.label: combat
variants.delta: It is A's beginning of combat step (step beginning_of_combat) and A has priority.
variants.expected: Casting Bonesplitter is not legal: can_play is false.

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: A has already cast Shock targeting B, tapping one Mountain. Shock is on the stack and A has priority.
variants.expected: Casting Bonesplitter is not legal: can_play is false while Shock is on the stack.

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: It is B's turn (active B), B's first main phase, the stack is empty and A has priority.
variants.expected: Casting Bonesplitter is not legal: can_play is false on B's turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: The stack_not_empty variant puts Shock on the stack with the stack field of the setup: [{"card": "Shock", "controller": "A", "targets": ["B"]}].

scenarios.title: A resolving artifact spell is put onto the battlefield under its controller's control
decisions: A casts Bonesplitter, tapping Mountain.
B has priority, holds Counterspell and passes.
A passes; Bonesplitter resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Bonesplitter resolves and moves from the stack to the battlefield under A's control, unattached.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B responds with Counterspell targeting Bonesplitter, tapping both Islands; Counterspell resolves first.
variants.expected: Counterspell resolves and counters Bonesplitter. Bonesplitter moves to A's graveyard and never reaches the battlefield. Counterspell moves to B's graveyard.

scenarios.title: An Equipment cannot be attached to a non-creature permanent

setup.notes: Mutavault is a land and not a creature unless animated. A has no creature.

decisions: A attempts to activate Bonesplitter's equip {1}, tapping one Mountain, with Mutavault as the only candidate permanent.

variants.label: mutavault_not_creature
variants.expected: The equip ability has no legal target (has_legal_target is false) and cannot be activated. Bonesplitter stays unattached.

variants.label: mutavault_animated
variants.delta: Before that, A activates Mutavault's animate ability {1}, tapping one Mountain, and it resolves; Mutavault is a 2/2 creature until end of turn. Then A activates equip {1} with the other Mountain, targeting Mutavault.
variants.expected: Mutavault is a legal target. Equip resolves and Bonesplitter is attached to Mutavault, which is a 4/2 land creature.

scenarios.title: An Equipment enters the battlefield unattached

setup.notes: Stonehewer Giant is untapped and not summoning sick. The library holds a second Bonesplitter (A's other card) for the Giant's search.

decisions: A casts Bonesplitter from hand, tapping one Plains.
Both players pass; Bonesplitter resolves.

variants.label: cast
variants.expected: Bonesplitter enters the battlefield unattached under A's control. Grizzly Bears is a 2/2.

variants.label: equip_after_cast
variants.delta: After Bonesplitter resolves, A also activates equip {1} with the other Plains, targeting Grizzly Bears, and it resolves.
variants.expected: Bonesplitter was unattached on entering. After the equip ability resolves it is attached to Grizzly Bears, which is a 4/2.

variants.label: put_by_giant
variants.delta: A does not cast Bonesplitter. A activates Stonehewer Giant ({1}{W}, tap, tapping both Plains), searching the library for Bonesplitter, putting it onto the battlefield and attaching it to Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Bonesplitter enters the battlefield unattached; the ability then attaches it to Grizzly Bears, which is a 4/2. The library is shuffled.

scenarios.forge_notes: No does_not_fire variant: every Equipment spell enters unattached, and the only Equipment that enters attached is one an effect puts onto the battlefield attached, which 301.5e-1 covers (its ordinary_creature variant).

scenarios.title: An effect that attaches an Equipment to an object that cannot be equipped by it leaves the Equipment unmoved

setup.notes: Angelic Curator has protection from artifacts, so it cannot be equipped by Bonesplitter. Sigarda's Aid is a white enchantment, so its trigger can target Angelic Curator.

decisions: A casts Bonesplitter, tapping Mountain; it resolves.
Sigarda's Aid triggers; A chooses to attach and targets Angelic Curator.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The trigger resolves and Bonesplitter does not move: it stays on the battlefield unattached. Angelic Curator is a 1/1.

variants.label: equippable_creature
variants.delta: The trigger targets Grizzly Bears instead of Angelic Curator.
variants.expected: Bonesplitter becomes attached to Grizzly Bears, which is a 4/2.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's Attach effect should refuse the attachment because of protection; confirm it leaves Bonesplitter unattached rather than attaching it.

scenarios.title: An Equipment attached to a permanent that is no longer a creature becomes unattached
decisions: A casts Song of the Dryads targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping three Forests.
Both players pass; Song of the Dryads resolves.

variants.label: equipped_creature_enchanted
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes a colorless Forest land and is no longer a creature. In the state-based check Bonesplitter becomes unattached and stays on the battlefield under A's control.

variants.label: other_creature_enchanted
variants.delta: Song of the Dryads targets Hill Giant instead.
variants.expected: Hill Giant becomes a colorless Forest land. Bonesplitter stays attached to Grizzly Bears, which is a 4/2.

scenarios.title: An Equipment that is also a creature cannot equip a creature

setup.notes: Sol Ring is not tapped for mana.

decisions: A casts Ensoul Artifact targeting Bonesplitter, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Ensoul Artifact resolves.

variants.label: equipment_ensouled
variants.expected: Bonesplitter is a 5/5 artifact creature. In the state-based check it becomes unattached from Grizzly Bears (a 2/2) and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: other_artifact_ensouled
variants.delta: Ensoul Artifact targets Sol Ring instead.
variants.expected: Sol Ring is a 5/5 artifact creature. Bonesplitter stays attached to Grizzly Bears, which is a 4/2.

scenarios.title: An Equipment whose creature has left the battlefield becomes unattached and stays on the battlefield
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves.

variants.label: equipped_creature_dies
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears (4/2 with Bonesplitter) has 2 damage and moves to A's graveyard. Bonesplitter stays on the battlefield, unattached, under A's control.

variants.label: other_creature_shocked
variants.delta: Shock targets Centaur Courser instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Centaur Courser (3/3) has 2 damage marked and survives. Bonesplitter stays attached to Grizzly Bears, which is a 4/2.

scenarios.title: Only the Equipment's controller can activate it, whoever controls the equipped creature

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears is owned by A. B controls it through Control Magic, which is attached to it. A controls Bonesplitter, which is attached to Grizzly Bears. Both Mountains are untapped.

decisions: B attempts to activate Bonesplitter's equip {1}, tapping Mountain, targeting B's Hill Giant.

variants.label: creature_controller_tries
variants.expected: B cannot activate the equip ability, because B does not control Bonesplitter: can_play is false. Bonesplitter stays attached to Grizzly Bears, which B controls as a 4/2. Bonesplitter stays under A's control.

variants.label: equipment_controller_tries
variants.delta: It is A's turn (active A) and A attempts to activate equip, tapping A's Mountain and targeting A's Hill Giant.
variants.expected: The activation is legal. Equip resolves and Bonesplitter moves to A's Hill Giant (5/3). Grizzly Bears, still controlled by B, is a 2/2.

scenarios.forge_notes: Reach the base state by having B resolve Control Magic on A's equipped Grizzly Bears earlier, or build it as a puzzle state.

scenarios.title: An Equipment put onto the battlefield attached to an object it cannot equip enters unattached

setup.notes: Angelic Curator has protection from artifacts.

decisions: A casts Unfinished Business targeting Angelic Curator and Bonesplitter in A's graveyard, tapping five Plains.
Both players pass; Unfinished Business resolves.

variants.label: protected_creature
variants.expected: Angelic Curator returns to the battlefield. Bonesplitter returns to the battlefield too, but unattached, because Angelic Curator has protection from artifacts. Unfinished Business moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: ordinary_creature
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears is in A's graveyard instead of Angelic Curator, and is the creature target.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears returns to the battlefield and Bonesplitter returns attached to it. Grizzly Bears is a 4/2.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may treat an Equipment that cannot be attached like an Aura that cannot enchant and leave it in the graveyard; the rules put it onto the battlefield unattached.

scenarios.title: A Fortification can be attached only to a land
decisions: A attempts to activate Darksteel Garrison's fortify {3}, targeting Grizzly Bears, paying with the three Mountains.

variants.label: target_creature
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is not a legal target: the fortify ability has no legal target for it and cannot be activated with it. Darksteel Garrison stays unattached.

variants.label: target_land
variants.delta: The fortify ability targets one of the Mountains instead.
variants.expected: The activation is legal. Fortify resolves and Darksteel Garrison is attached to that Mountain, which has indestructible.

scenarios.title: A Fortification that is also a creature cannot fortify a land

setup.notes: Sol Ring is not tapped for mana.

decisions: A casts Ensoul Artifact targeting Darksteel Garrison, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Ensoul Artifact resolves.

variants.label: fortification_ensouled
variants.expected: Darksteel Garrison is a 5/5 artifact creature. In the state-based check it becomes unattached from Mountain and stays on the battlefield. Mountain no longer has indestructible.

variants.label: other_artifact_ensouled
variants.delta: Ensoul Artifact targets Sol Ring instead.
variants.expected: Sol Ring is a 5/5 artifact creature. Darksteel Garrison stays attached to Mountain, which has indestructible.

scenarios.title: A Vehicle has power and toughness only while it is a creature

setup.notes: Smuggler's Copter has printed power and toughness 3/3 and crew 1.

decisions: No action is taken; the board is observed in A's first main phase.

variants.label: not_crewed
variants.expected: Smuggler's Copter is a noncreature artifact and has no power or toughness.

variants.label: crewed
variants.delta: A first activates crew 1, tapping Grizzly Bears, and the ability resolves.
variants.expected: Smuggler's Copter is an artifact creature with power 3 and toughness 3 until end of turn.

scenarios.title: A Vehicle that becomes a creature immediately has its printed power and toughness, modified by other effects

setup.notes: The +1/+1 counter sits on Smuggler's Copter while it is not a creature.

decisions: A activates crew 1, tapping Grizzly Bears; the ability resolves.

variants.label: with_counter
variants.expected: Smuggler's Copter becomes a creature with printed 3/3 plus the +1/+1 counter, so it is a 4/4 as soon as the crew ability resolves.

variants.label: without_counter
variants.expected: Smuggler's Copter becomes a creature with exactly its printed 3/3.
